content: Browser platform APIs are sufficient for canvas connector geometry: DOM elements expose bounding boxes, SVG can draw absolute-positioned connector paths, ResizeObserver can watch layout changes, and requestAnimationFrame can coalesce measurement/redraw work. Recommendation: use native DOM plus an SVG connector layer, with ResizeObserver/rAF as internal helpers; defer canvas/WebGL/diagram libraries unless many hundreds of visible connectors require profiling-driven optimization.
